methodology_re_review.mauryan_claim: Re-reviewed after the evidence-synthesis methodology reset. The apparent Megasthenes-versus-Indian-text contradiction is no longer treated mechanically as an unresolved dispute. The working designation is P2/classified, while Megasthenes remains linked as challenging evidence and the claim explicitly avoids Greek-category equivalence or economy-wide prevalence claims.

unresolved_issues: Mauryan slavery is positively classified at P2 after synthesis, but terminology and comparability with Greek chattel slavery remain materially qualified; the classification does not imply that slavery dominated the Mauryan economy.
Middle Ganga valley is an analytical region with explicit unresolved geometry.
The Silla Village Register's date remains disputed; the 695–819 interval encodes competing proposed dates, not continuous evidence.
The four Silla register villages remain spatially unresolved; no whole-Silla polygon is substituted.
The Baekje 369 claim is a bounded war-captive enslavement event and is not used to infer Baekje-wide prevalence.
No claim in this batch is part of a public release.
